description: Batch sentiment + aspects — Sentiment for up to 25 texts in one call (reviews, survey answers, tickets, social posts). texts = items separated by | or newlines, or a JSON array. Per item: positive / negative / neutral / mixed, a score from -1 to 1 (forced to agree with the label offline), an emotion word and up to 3 aspects with their own sentiment (aspects=false to skip; topic= to focus). Roll-up: counts, average score, net sentiment index (positive minus negative, per 100), overall verdict, the most negative and most positive items, and the most-mentioned aspects with positive/negative split. Workers AI llama-3.3-70b. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

texts.description: e.g. Fast shipping and great quality|Support never answered my emails|It is ok I guess

name: ai_sentiment_batch
